results.title: Bitcoin nears $80,000 in its biggest weekly rally in 3 years
results.description: Bitcoin surged toward $80,000 on Saturday, gaining 24.5% over the past week and heading for its strongest weekly rally in more than three years. The rally was supported by lower long-term US bond yields, increased risk appetite, short-position liquidations and renewed institutional buying.
